critical_schema_transformations.note: ALL table references have been transformed by DMS. These MUST be respected in code integration.

transaction_management.description: These methods contain complex transaction blocks that cannot be directly executed as single SQL statements in PostgreSQL. Transaction management must be moved to C# application level using NpgsqlConnection.BeginTransaction(), NpgsqlTransaction.Commit(), and NpgsqlTransaction.Rollback().
transaction_management.implementation_approach: Split each transaction into multiple SQL statements. Execute them sequentially within a try-catch block with application-level transaction control.

variable_handling.description: SQL Server variables (@NewProductId, @OldPrice, @OldStock) must be handled in C# code. Retrieve values before executing subsequent statements.
variable_handling.implementation_approach: Use ExecuteScalarAsync for retrieving single values, store in C# variables, then pass as parameters to subsequent statements.

returning_clause.description: SCOPE_IDENTITY() replaced with RETURNING clause. The returned value must be captured in C# code.
returning_clause.implementation_approach: Use ExecuteScalarAsync or ExecuteReaderAsync to capture the RETURNING clause value.
